rules.name: cs-25-diff-quick-20nov-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows_in_cache, min(value_date) AS min_value_date, max(value_date) AS max_value_date, CASE WHEN min(value_date) = :valueDate AND max(value_date) = :valueDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cache_on_value_date FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(business_unit) = 'CFS'

SELECT g.* FROM ( SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, lower(c.market_action) AS market_action, 'fixing_date' AS group_key, c.fixing_date AS group_date, count(*) AS legs, sum(abs(c.active_lots)) AS nominal, sum(abs(c.active_lots) * c.traded_price) / nullif(sum(abs(c.active_lots)), 0) AS wavg_exact, round((sum(abs(c.active_lots) * c.traded_price) / nullif(sum(abs(c.active_lots)), 0))::numeric, 4) AS wavg_4dp, round((sum(abs(c.active_lots) * c.traded_price) / nullif(sum(abs(c.active_lots)), 0))::numeric, 6) AS wavg_6dp, round((sum(abs(c.active_lots) * round(c.traded_price::numeric, 4)) / nullif(sum(abs(c.active_lots)), 0))::numeric, 8) AS wavg_leg4_8dp, round((sum(round(abs(c.active_lots)::numeric, 2) * c.traded_price) / nullif(sum(round(abs(c.active_lots)::numeric, 2)), 0))::numeric, 8) AS wavg_nominal2_8dp FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(c.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND c.derivative_type LIKE 'fx_forward%' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) = ANY (string_to_array(:fxClients, ',')) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 UNION ALL SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)), lower(c.market_action), 'settlement_date', c.settlement_date, count(*), sum(abs(c.active_lots)), sum(abs(c.active_lots) * c.traded_price) / nullif(sum(abs(c.active_lots)), 0), round((sum(abs(c.active_lots) * c.traded_price) / nullif(sum(abs(c.active_lots)), 0))::numeric, 4), round((sum(abs(c.active_lots) * c.traded_price) / nullif(sum(abs(c.active_lots)), 0))::numeric, 6), round((sum(abs(c.active_lots) * round(c.traded_price::numeric, 4)) / nullif(sum(abs(c.active_lots)), 0))::numeric, 8), round((sum(round(abs(c.active_lots)::numeric, 2) * c.traded_price) / nullif(sum(round(abs(c.active_lots)::numeric, 2)), 0))::numeric, 8) FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(c.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND c.derivative_type LIKE 'fx_forward%' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) = ANY (string_to_array(:fxClients, ',')) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) g WHERE abs(g.nominal - 644537.48) < 0.5 OR abs(g.nominal - 98831.03) < 0.5 ORDER BY g.client, g.nominal, g.group_key

SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, lower(c.market_action) AS market_action, c.fixing_date, count(*) AS legs, sum(abs(c.active_lots)) AS nominal FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(c.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND c.derivative_type LIKE 'fx_forward%' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) = ANY (string_to_array(:fxClients, ',')) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY sum(abs(c.active_lots)) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.derivative_type, count(*) AS legs, sum(c.mtm_usd) AS sum_exact, round(sum(c.mtm_usd)::numeric, 2) AS rounded_sum, sum(round(c.mtm_usd::numeric, 2)) AS sum_of_leg_rounded FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(c.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) = upper(:totalClient) GROUP BY c.derivative_type ORDER BY c.derivative_type

SELECT b.contract_number, b.contract_month, b.client_code, b.sub_account, b.structure_name, b.trade_date FROM opera.client_statement_booking_order_information_table b WHERE b.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(b.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND b.contract_number IN ('SMH_OU_056', 'SMH_OU_057', 'SMH_OU_060') ORDER BY b.contract_number

SELECT b.contract_number, b.contract_month, b.client_code, b.sub_account, b.structure_name, b.trade_date FROM dbsystemuat.client_statement_booking_order_information_table_cfs b WHERE b.contract_number IN ('SMH_OU_056', 'SMH_OU_057', 'SMH_OU_060') ORDER BY b.contract_number
